text: Does the organization classify data based on sensitivity levels?
What are the data retention requirements for financial data?
Is multi-factor authentication required for all users?
How quickly must access be revoked when an employee is terminated?
What is the organization's Recovery Time Objective (RTO)?
Is data encrypted at rest using AES-256?
Are background checks performed on all employees before hire?
Does the organization enforce a clean desk policy?
Are code reviews required before deploying to production?
Are audit logs maintained for all administrative actions?
Does the organization perform vulnerability scanning on all systems?
Are there policies governing the portability of data between cloud providers?
Are penetration tests conducted annually on external facing applications?
Does the company mandate data obfuscation or masking in non-production environments?
Does the organization maintain physical security controls at its data centers?
Are endpoint devices managed with a unified endpoint management solution?
Does the organization use automated source code analysis (SAST) tools?
Is there a formal supply chain risk management program to evaluate third-party vendors?
Does the company consume threat intelligence feeds from external sources?
Are physical access logs to the datacenter reviewed quarterly?
